lang.label: Language
queue.title: Images
dnd.title: Drop your images here
dnd.hint: or click to browse — PNG, JPEG, WebP, AVIF, GIF, BMP, ICO, SVG, TIFF
options.title: Settings
options.keepAnimationHint: For an animated GIF input and a GIF output. Unchecked: only the first frame is kept.
options.qualityHint: Compression for lossy formats; ignored for PNG, BMP, ICO and TIFF.
options.backgroundHint: Used when “Transparent background” is unchecked or the format cannot store alpha.
options.keepTransparencyHint: Keeps alpha for PNG, WebP, AVIF, ICO, TIFF and GIF (1-bit). Uncheck to flatten onto the chosen color.
options.removeMetadataHint: For JPEG→JPEG, EXIF is kept only when this box is unchecked.
preview.title: Preview
preview.empty: Select an image to see the preview.
toast.fetching: Fetching the image from the page…
toast.nothingToDownload: Nothing to download: run a conversion first.
toast.copiedPng: Image copied as PNG (the only format Chrome accepts).
warnings.svg-rasterized: The source SVG is rasterized to pixels.
warnings.gif-static: The output GIF is static: only one frame is kept.
warnings.gif-256: GIF is limited to 256 colors: gradients may be altered.
warnings.gif-alpha: GIF transparency is limited to 1 bit: semi-transparent pixels become opaque or transparent.
warnings.ico-resized: Resized to {max} px maximum for ICO.
warnings.tiff-decode-experimental: Experimental TIFF decoding: some variants may fail.
warnings.animation-first-frame: Animated image: only the first frame is converted.
warnings.exif-stripped: EXIF cannot be kept when converting to this format.
warnings.exif-absent: No EXIF metadata to preserve in this file.
warnings.exif-orientation-baked: EXIF orientation {orientation} was already applied to pixels; the tag is reset to 1.
errors.heic-unsupported: HEIC/HEIF is not supported yet (planned for v1.1).
errors.tiff-decode-failed: Could not decode this TIFF (unsupported variant).
errors.svg-no-size: SVG without usable dimensions (width/height or viewBox required).
errors.image-too-large: Image too large for the canvas ({width} × {height} px; max {max} px per side).
errors.animation-too-long: GIF too long: {frames} frames (maximum {max}). Uncheck “Keep animation” or shorten the GIF.
errors.clipboard-denied: The browser denied clipboard access. Keep the popup open and try again.
errors.clipboard-unsupported: Image clipboard is not available here.
errors.fetch-failed: Could not fetch the image from the page (CORS or network).
